scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @authsphere/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @authsphere/web
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build:shared && npm run generate:api && npm run build:lambda -w @authsphere/api && npm run zip:lambda
scripts.zip:lambda: cd infra/lambda && bestzip authsphere-api.zip lambda.mjs lambda.mjs.map node_modules/
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run generate:api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
